comparison.objective: Tune and lock a shock absorber versus set and lock a telescoping gauge to a bore diameter.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve fine mechanical adjustment and lock retention; the record additionally requires sweeping the gauge through a bore and extracting it without changing span.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate tests repeated dynamic stopping and witness-torque retention; record tests span within 0.10 mm and released placement on a stand.
comparison.reason: The shared set-and-lock primitive is generic; dynamic response tuning is a meaningfully different tested ability from dimensional transfer. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds are missing.
